description: Prepare a listing of a property the wallet holds on Fabrica (Sepolia Testnet) at a USD price paid in USDC, open for expiresDays (default 180). Checks first that the wallet holds the token, and warns when the price is far from Fabrica's estimate, when the wallet already lists it, when an offer is at or above the price, or when the property is collateral for a loan. Prepared, not sent: returns a signRequest (summary, warnings, signLink to fabrica.land, expiresAt 15 minutes out, payload null for now) and stores it so the sign page can load it. The person opens the link, signs in with that wallet and signs; nothing happens until then. The server holds no keys and submits nothing. wallet is the address that will sign.

priceUsd.description: Asking price in US dollars, paid in USDC

tokenId.description: The token ID of the property

wallet.description: The wallet that will sign (0x address). The sign page only lets this wallet sign.
